frida_cs: Quick flag — BorealisAI showing a steep activity drop, renewal in ~3 weeks. Daily requests down ~71% this month.
runbot: [ALERT] BorealisAI - Usage -71% (30d), Active seats: 12/70, Health: 34/100. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/borealisai/health
owen_csm: any notes on why? champion churn or perf?
tasha_ae: Sales notes: their infrastructure lead (our champion) took a new role; they asked Sales for a demo from LumenAI and a pricing delta last Friday.
mike_sre: I pulled recent traces — p99 tail correlated with a checkpoint stall during KV flushes on Feb 12. Opened ENG-9988 for a conservative fallback and cache ttl adjustment.
frida_cs: timeline summary: champion departure + infra tail spikes + competitor pilot. Treat as "at-risk" and escalate renewal play.
owen_csm: proposed immediate actions: 1) short 15-min technical check-in with their interim owner 2) run a focused 7-day latency bench on their sample corpus (we'll provide config + results) 3) canary patch for ENG-9988 (if safe) 4) offer 30 days of discounted capacity to maintain usage
mike_sre: patch is small (KV fallback + TTL tweak). ETA for canary: 48h if CI goes green. I'll attach before/after p50/p95/p99 graphs.
tasha_ae: I'll call the buyer and ask what Lumen demo emphasized — latency, price, or feature set. If they ask for numbers, we can commit to a bench report within 72h.
frida_cs: assigning owners: @tasha_ae outreach + competitive intel; @mike_sre infra fix + bench; @owen_csm lead renewal and credits ask. I'll prepare a 1-pg exec summary for leadership.
renewal-bot: [REMINDER] Follow-up checkpoint in 48h: please update this thread with customer reply or status.
frida_cs: quick SQL I ran to confirm drop: ```SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE account='borealisai' AND ts > now()-interval '30 days'; -- 58 (prev 200)```
owen_csm: thumbs up. I'll ping them now and drop a calendar invite for a 15-min sync. Keep the canary ready. :thumbsup:
